description: Extract advertising, character, audio, product, and brand metadata from short commercial videos.

fieldSchema.description: Extract structured commercial-analysis attributes from the full video.

AdvertiserBrand.description: Primary advertiser or brand promoted in the video.

VisibleProducts.description: Products, services, devices, apps, logos, UI elements, or branded assets visibly shown or clearly referenced.

CompetitorsMentioned.description: Competitor brands or products explicitly named, shown, or clearly referenced in the commercial. Return an empty array if none are identified.

InsuranceProductsMentioned.description: Insurance products explicitly mentioned, visibly shown, or clearly implied in the commercial, such as home insurance, auto insurance, renters insurance, life insurance, or bundled home and auto.

Characters.description: Named or role-based characters visible or speaking in the video. Use role descriptions when names are not available.

CharacterRoles.description: Summarize the main character roles and how they contribute to the commercial.

MusicAndAudio.description: Describe audible music, jingles, sound effects, crowd noise, TV audio, voiceover, and tone. If no music is clearly audible, say so.

Setting.description: Describe the main locations and environments shown in the commercial.

KeyActions.description: Important visual actions or story beats that occur in the commercial.

OnScreenText.description: Readable text, captions, disclaimers, logos, slogans, or end-card copy shown on screen.

CommercialMessage.description: Central advertising message, offer, or call to action.

CallToAction.description: Specific action the commercial asks or encourages viewers to take, such as visiting a website, calling, downloading an app, or purchasing. If none is stated or implied, say no clear call to action.

HumorMechanism.description: Explain what makes the commercial humorous, including recurring jokes, character behavior, or situational irony.

EmotionSentiment.description: Describe the dominant emotion or sentiment conveyed by the commercial and, when useful, how it changes across the video.

SportsOrEntertainmentReferences.description: Sports, entertainment, TV, streaming, or game-watching references in the video.

BrandSafetyNotes.description: Mention any potentially sensitive visual or spoken content. If none is apparent, say no obvious brand-safety concerns are visible or spoken.
